messages:
eli_support: Escalating Meridian Health onboarding to CS. Account MID-501, ARR ~$320k. Ingests failing with 422 and intermittent 401s. Renewal ping in 12 days. Need CS to run bridge + comms plan.

eli_support: Quick logs: repeated validation failure on `record.notes` and an auth 401 with detail 'invalid_refresh_token'. Also saw burst of parallel uploads ~3x.

pager-bot: [incident] Created P1 case INC-2026-259 for MID-501 assigned to customer-success. SLA: 2 business hours for initial outreach.

nora_cs: I'll take lead. Can support attach the last 100 lines and confirm whether the 401s are clustered or spread? Planning a 20m triage call and will include Eng.

eli_support: Attached trimmed logs to INC-2026-259. 401s clustered around 2026-04-18T11:05Z during retries. Enabled org debug for 12h: `enable_org_debug MID-501 --ttl=12h`.

sam_se: Likely two issues: schema mismatch for `record.notes` (expects string, getting object) + token refresh cadence mismatch. Short-term: offer a 24h quota/throughput bump and a canary secret rotate. I can apply bump if CS approves. Runbook: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/onboard-triage

claire_csm: Comms plan: 1) immediate 20m triage call within 1h, 2) present temporary mitigations (quota bump + rotation) during call, 3) send follow-up email with remediation steps and timeline; escalate to Renewals if unresolved after 24h. I'll draft the invite and the email.

nora_cs: Proposed time 11:45 PT. @sam_se pls join. @eli_support pls enable debug (done). I'll send calendar and the short status note to the customer now.

eli_support: Calendar invite sent. Marking INC-2026-259 as P1 and cc'ing sales for renewal visibility.

sam_se: I applied a temporary throughput bump: `set_org_qps MID-501 --qps=250 --duration=24h`. Starting canary rotate on a test workspace now.

claire_csm: Draft message to customer:
"Hi Marco — we see a schema mismatch and a token refresh issue. Scheduling a 20m troubleshooting call at 11:45 PT to walk a corrected payload sample and rotate the integration token if needed. We'll apply a short-term throughput increase to reduce failures and follow up with next steps. — Claire, CSM"

nora_cs: Post-call update: canary rotate succeeded, test workspace ingests OK, throughput bump active. Customer retried a failed batch and succeeded. Next steps: monitor 48h, deliver schema sample + small validator script, schedule hardening session next week, and keep Renewals on standby. Closing loop in INC-2026-259 once stable. :white_check_mark:
